attempts.code:
obs = observe()
zone = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
zone_center = zone["center"]
rim_height = zone.get("rim_height", 0.08)
table_z = obs["table_z"]
pen = obs["objects"]["yellow_pen"]

cands = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
# Filter across short side (squeeze_width fits open fingers)
valid_cands = [c for c in cands if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True)]
valid_cands.sort(key=lambda c: c.get("score", 0), reverse=True)

grasped = False
for cand in valid_cands:
    # Set grasp height equal to pen height (~0.012 m) so fingertips reach table
    cand_use = dict(cand)
    cand_use["height"] = max(pen["height"], 0.012)
    res = grasp(cand_use)
    if res.get("holding_something", False):
        grasped = True
        break

if not grasped:
    # Try best candidate directly
    for cand in valid_cands:
        res = grasp(cand)
        if res.get("holding_something", False):
            grasped = True
            break

safe_z = table_z + rim_height + 0.15
carry_to(zone_center[0], zone_center[1], height=safe_z - table_z)

# Orient vertically above the holder
candidate_orientations = [
    ([1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]),
    ([0, 1, 0], [1, 0, 0]),
    ([-1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]),
    ([0, -1, 0], [1, 0, 0]),
]

selected_app, selected_fa = None, None
for app, fa in candidate_orientations:
    ik_res = solve_ik(zone_center[0], zone_center[1], safe_z, approach=app, finger_axis=fa)
    if ik_res.get("reachable", False):
        selected_app, selected_fa = app, fa
        break

if selected_app is not None:
    move_gripper(zone_center[0], zone_center[1], safe_z, approach=selected_app, finger_axis=selected_fa, path="line")

# Release from safe height above rim so it drops upright into holder
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("yellow_pen", "magenta_holder")
